{"content": "import Policy.Bounties
open Wallet

namespace Solution

theorem step_allow_cap (p : Policy) (s s' : State) (now : UInt64) (to : Account)
    (amount : UInt64) (h : step p s now to amount = (.allow, s')) : amount ≤ p.perTxCap := by
  unfold step at h
  split at h
  · split at h
    · cases h
    · next hnlt => exact UInt64.not_lt.mp hnlt
  · cases h

theorem key (p : Policy) : ∀ (reqs : List Req) (s : State) (vs : List Verdict),
    (run p s reqs).2 = vs → ∀ r ∈ acceptedReqs reqs vs, r.2.2 ≤ p.perTxCap := by
  intro reqs
  induction reqs with
  | nil =>
    intro s vs hvs r hr
    cases hr
  | cons q qs ih =>
    intro s vs hvs r hr
    obtain ⟨now, to, amount⟩ := q
    cases e : step p s now to amount with
    | mk v s' =>
      have e2 : (run p s ((now, to, amount) :: qs)).2 = vs := hvs
      unfold run at e2
      rw [e] at e2
      cases e3 : (run p s' qs).2 with
      | nil =>
        rw [e3] at e2
        cases e2
        cases hr
      | cons w ws =>
        rw [e3] at e2
        injection e2 with h1 _
        subst h1
        have htail := ih s' (w :: ws) e3
        cases v with
        | allow =>
          unfold acceptedReqs at hr
          cases hr with
          | head => exact step_allow_cap p s s' now to amount e
          | tail _ hmem => exact htail r hmem
        | denyBudget => unfold acceptedReqs at hr; exact htail r hr
        | denyPerTx => unfold acceptedReqs at hr; exact htail r hr
        | denyDaily => unfold acceptedReqs at hr; exact htail r hr
        | denyReceiver => unfold acceptedReqs at hr; exact htail r hr
        | denyOverflow => unfold acceptedReqs at hr; exact htail r hr

theorem proof : Wallet.Claim.PerTxCapAlways := by
  intro p s reqs r hr
  exact key p reqs s (run p s reqs).2 rfl r hr

end Solution
"}
